# Production-Ready Predictive Analytics Platform (Capstone)

Build a complete, reproducible machine-learning workflow using a realistic classification or regression task.

## Required behavior
- [ ] Data validation
- [ ] Preprocessing and baseline models
- [ ] Candidate model comparison
- [ ] Leakage-safe cross-validation
- [ ] Hyperparameter tuning
- [ ] Feature inspection
- [ ] Final evaluation
- [ ] Model persistence and inference interface
- [ ] Testing, documentation and limitations

Use a synthetic or properly licensed dataset. Keep training, selection, and final evaluation separate. Document setup, package versions, evaluation, limitations, and reset instructions.

"""Starter scaffold. Complete one milestone at a time and keep evaluation honest."""

def main():
    # TODO: load the supplied dataset and inspect columns and shapes.
    # TODO: define a baseline before selecting a model.
    # TODO: build the preprocessing + estimator pipeline where appropriate.
    # TODO: evaluate on data not used to tune the model.
    # TODO: record package versions, tests, assumptions, and limitations.
    print("Project scaffold: replace TODOs with a reproducible workflow.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Copy the course dataset `assets/data/house-prices.csv` into this project's `data/` directory as described in README. This is synthetic teaching data; do not interpret it as real people or transactions.

dataset_note: Where provided, use only for educational practice. Data files are deterministic synthetic examples and contain no real people. Copy into the starter project before running it.
stretch_features: Add automated tests for edge cases and invalid inputs.
Record dataset and package versions plus configuration in a machine-readable experiment report.
Compare one alternative method and explain why the preferred method fits the intended use.

tests.name: Functional behavior
criteria: Required behavior works on the documented input.
The output or prediction contract is stated and checked.

tests.name: Evaluation and reproducibility
criteria: The baseline and test strategy match the task.
The results can be reproduced from the documented setup.

tests.name: Safety, privacy, and limitations
criteria: Only synthetic or licensed data are used.
Limitations and failure cases are documented; no unsupported real-world claims are made.

rubric.criterion: Data handling, privacy and responsible interpretation
